task_message:
Case N20: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 301x301x442 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. Summary:

- **Lesion found:** a long, fusiform T2-hyperintense mass in the posterior/posterolateral compartment of the limb, showing a "target sign" (bright periphery with a relatively hypointense center) — characteristic of a peripheral nerve sheath tumor. It was tracked across axial, coronal and sagittal planes.
- **Segmentation:** seeded with one positive point on the lesion, then refined with the model. Final mask is a single connected component of 38.1 mL spanning axial slices 221–352 (~130 mm), coronal 98–122 and sagittal 161–194, closely following the lesion's bright rim and tapering ends.
- **Verification:** all six past-the-mask review panels showed no residual lesion tissue, no extra candidate corrections were proposed, and the boundary was confirmed on zoomed axial/coronal/sagittal views; confidence **high**.
